papers.title: Post-OCR Correction of Mixed-Script Uzbek Text: Byte-Level ByT5 with an Empirical Homoglyph Noise Matrix
papers.summary: In Uzbek official and technical documents, a large share of OCR errors is caused not by poor image quality but by characters that are visually identical across the two alphabets in use. Because the script transition is still under way, Cyrillic and Latin appear on the same page and often within a single sentence, and in our measurements the density of homoglyph errors on such pages is close to five times higher than in single-script text. We study this problem in a setting where the corpus of engineering-geological and ICT infrastructure reports may not leave the organisation, so every stage was executed on local hardware. The proposed system combines a byte-level ByT5 model with a noise generator whose sampling weights are estimated from 359 manually classified error events, together with a Levenshtein-bounded conservative decoding rule. On a Gold set of 5,204 line pairs it lowers the character error rate from 0.0578 to 0.0369, restores 91.3% of the homoglyphs and introduces only 84 new errors.
papers.zh_summary: 针对乌兹别克语官方与技术文档中拉丁字母与西里尔字母混排导致的同形异码字错误（混排页密度约为单文种文本的五倍），在数据不可离线的本地硬件条件下，提出字节级ByT5纠错模型，配合权重由359个人工标注错误事件估计的同形噪声生成器，以及Levenshtein约束的保守解码规则。在5,204行对的金标准集上，字符错误率由0.0578降至0.0369，同形字恢复率91.3%，仅引入84个新错误。
papers.novelty: 将同形异码噪声的实测分布显式建模为可采样噪声矩阵，并与字节级序列到序列纠错及受限解码结合，形成面向混排文种的OCR后处理流水线；全部流程在本地环境完成，面向数据不可外流场景。
innovation_points: 以359个人工分类的错误事件估计同形异码噪声矩阵的采样权重，使合成噪声分布贴近真实错误
采用字节级ByT5建模，规避混排文种下字符表膨胀与未登录字符问题
引入Levenshtein距离上界的保守解码规则，以约束纠错改动幅度、抑制过纠正
任务设定明确针对同一页面甚至同一句子内西里尔与拉丁混排的OCR后处理
papers.limitations: 噪声矩阵规模有限（359个标注事件），对低频同形组合的覆盖可能不足；仅在工程地质与ICT报告的私有语料与5,204行对金标准集上验证，跨领域与跨文种泛化性未知；保守解码以字符错误率为主要优化目标，未报告词级或下游任务指标；未与通用拼写纠错或多语言预训练模型做充分对比。
improvement_directions: 扩大同形噪声标注规模并引入跨文种（如塞尔维亚语、阿塞拜疆语）迁移验证，检验噪声矩阵的可移植性
将字符级同形先验与词级语言模型或词典约束联合解码，降低保守解码带来的漏纠
报告词级准确率、命名实体与数值字段等下游指标，评估纠错对结构化抽取的实际收益
探索在图像侧引入字形相似度约束，使噪声建模与视觉证据联动而非仅依赖文本侧统计
papers.engineering_value: 系统全程可在本地硬件运行，契合文档不可外流的机构需求；字符错误率相对下降约36%且新增错误极少，可直接嵌入现有OCR流水线作为后处理模块，对混排文种文档的数字化归档与检索质量有明显提升。
papers.why_relevant: 该工作直接处理OCR后处理中的文种混排与同形字错误，属于文档解析中错误纠正环节的典型问题，其噪声建模与受限解码思路可迁移至其他多文种文档场景。

papers.title: Word-Level Alignment of OCR and Ground Truth under Zoning and Reading-Order Errors
papers.summary: OCR post-processing needs OCR text aligned word by word with its ground truth. Data sets rarely provide that mapping, and a monotone aligner can lose its place when zoning errors permute the reading order. We revisit this problem, the Zoning Problem of our 2019 paper, with a protocol that tests correctness under such permutations. We apply OCR-side reading-order permutations with construction-time word-level gold and score correct-match F1, cascade length and recovery. We compare the 2019 location-aware aligner, a re-anchoring extension of it, a RETAS-style baseline (RETAS-lite), a multi-region aligner that combines unique-word and unique n-gram anchors with chunk-to-window assignment, genalog's RETAS and the original Java RETAS. Experiments use synthetic character noise with block moves, paragraph swaps and column interleaving, historical newspaper reading-order permutations, geometry-derived gold for Tesseract OCR, and a small word-box set. Synthetic tests show where local tracking fails after large displacements and where unique-anchor methods collapse when unique anchors are scarce. On our synthetic boilerplate page the 2019 method had the highest F1 among those tested. Historical newspaper and geometry-derived evaluations carry the limitations of approximate gold and the article-order convention. The first multi-region version has a quadratic scaling cost. Local tracking remains fragile under large reading-order changes; the tested anchor-based methods handle many of those cases but fail when unique anchors are scarce. Approximate gold, the article-order convention, missing residual annotation, and the lack of modern multi-column word-level ground truth remain limitations.
papers.zh_summary: 针对OCR后处理所需的OCR文本与真值词级对齐问题，重新审视此前提出的Zoning Problem，即区域切分错误导致阅读顺序置换时单调对齐器失位的问题。作者构造可施加阅读顺序置换的评测协议，比较2019年位置感知对齐器、其重锚定扩展、RETAS-lite基线、结合唯一词与唯一n-gram锚点及块到窗口分配的多区域对齐器、genalog的RETAS与原版Java RETAS，并在合成字符噪声加块移动、段落交换、列交错、历史报纸阅读顺序置换、Tesseract几何真值等设定下评估正确匹配F1、级联长度与恢复能力。
papers.novelty: 将阅读顺序置换显式纳入词级对齐的评测协议，系统比较局部跟踪、重锚定与多区域锚点三类方法在位移与锚点稀缺条件下的失效模式。
innovation_points: 设计与构造时词级真值配套的阅读顺序置换评测协议，量化对齐器在大位移后的失位与恢复行为
提出多区域对齐器，组合唯一词与唯一n-gram锚点并配合块到窗口分配处理区域置换
引入重锚定机制扩展原位置感知对齐器，并与RETAS系列实现做统一对比
使用几何推导真值与词框小样本集，补充历史报纸等真实阅读顺序场景的评估
papers.limitations: 历史报纸与几何真值评估受近似真值与文章顺序约定所限；多区域对齐器首版具有二次方扩展成本；局部跟踪在大幅阅读顺序变化下仍脆弱，锚点稀缺时基于锚点的方法同样失效；评估以合成噪声与传统OCR为主，未覆盖现代文档解析模型的输出分布。
improvement_directions: 将多区域对齐的二次方成本降至近线性，例如通过候选窗口剪枝或分块索引
设计锚点稀缺时的回退策略，如利用版面几何与语言模型打分替代唯一锚点
构建含真实区域切分错误与阅读顺序错误的大规模词级对齐基准，减少对近似真值的依赖
将对齐方法扩展至现代文档解析流水线的输出，包括段落级重排与表格结构还原结果
papers.engineering_value: 为OCR后处理中的数据构造与对齐质量评估提供可复现协议与多种实现对比，可直接用于训练数据自动标注与错误分析工具链，帮助定位区域切分与阅读顺序错误引发的下游对齐失败。
papers.why_relevant: 词级对齐是OCR纠错、评测与训练数据构建的基础环节，阅读顺序与区域切分错误是文档解析中的常见失败源，该工作的方法比较与失效分析对构建稳健的后处理流程具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry
papers.summary: Ottoman Divan poetry is composed in aruz, a quantitative meter based on the weights of syllables. The meter is sensitive to specific characters recorded in the original writing in the Arabic script. This work is concerned with automatic meter finding and scansion alignment for Ottoman Divan poetry, especially on modern Turkish spelling without the special diacritics that scholarly transliterations of Ottoman preserve. We define two tasks on this input, first identifying the meter used in the poem, and second aligning the meter's weights with the syllabification of the poem, identifying the flaws and freedoms the poet has taken along the way. We build a corpus of 52,000 lines split by poet, with scansion annotations for 500 test lines, and a robustness benchmark generated at the deviation rates measured on real web and OCR copies. Our model is a hidden Markov model over the positions of each meter, decoded over a lattice of every candidate path, and trained by EM from the printed meter, without scansion labels. On a held-out set it scans 77.6% of the test lines fully correctly, against 26.8% for the available rule-based scanner, 55.0% for a neural tagger trained with the same supervision and 63.6% for Claude Opus 5.5 few-shot. The code is open-sourced and the tool is released on the web.
papers.zh_summary: 面向奥斯曼迪万诗歌的aruz（基于音节轻重的定量格律）自动识别与格律对齐，输入为缺失特殊变音符号的现代土耳其语拼写。作者定义格律识别与格律—音节切分对齐两个任务，构建按诗人划分的52,000行语料，为500行测试集提供格律标注，并按真实网络与OCR副本测得的偏差率生成鲁棒性基准。模型为定义在每种格律位置上的隐马尔可夫模型，在全部候选路径构成的格网上解码，仅用印刷格律名以EM训练，无需格律标注。留出集上77.6%的测试行完全正确，规则扫描器为26.8%，同等监督的神经序列标注器为55.0%，Claude Opus 5.5少样本为63.6%。
papers.novelty: 将格律扫描建模为格网上的HMM解码问题，仅以印刷格律名作弱监督，通过EM训练，在缺失变音符号的现代拼写输入上显著优于规则方法与神经基线。
innovation_points: 在候选路径格网上定义HMM解码，把格律识别与音节权重对齐统一为序列推断任务
仅使用每首诗的印刷格律名作为弱监督，通过EM估计模型参数，避免逐音节标注
构建按诗人划分的5.2万行语料与500行标注测试集，并按实测偏差率生成面向网络与OCR噪声的鲁棒性基准
显式建模诗人沿格律的瑕疵与自由度，同时输出格律对齐与偏差位置
papers.limitations: 聚焦奥斯曼迪万诗歌这一特定文种与格律体系，方法向其他定量格律传统的迁移性未验证；鲁棒性基准按实测偏差率合成，与真实OCR错误分布仍有差距；77.6%的整行完全正确率意味着约两成行仍存在扫描错误；未报告对齐位置的细粒度错误分析。
improvement_directions: 将HMM与字符级或子词级神经声学式模型结合，改进变音符号缺失条件下的音节权重推断
在真实OCR输出而非合成偏差上评估并迭代噪声模型，检验对历史印刷体识别错误的稳健性
扩展至其他定量格律传统（如波斯、阿拉伯诗歌），检验格网HMM框架的通用性
引入格律约束辅助历史OCR后处理，例如以格律合法性作为纠错候选的过滤信号
papers.engineering_value: 提供开源工具与网页服务，可作为奥斯曼诗歌数字化项目的格律校验与标注辅助组件；其以格律合法性约束文本的思路也可为历史文献OCR的纠错与验证提供额外信号。
papers.why_relevant: 论文涉及OCR副本噪声下的鲁棒性评估，并将结构化格律约束用于文本验证，与文档解析中的历史文献识别及后处理校验相关，但其核心任务为格律扫描而非OCR本身。

papers.title: Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agentic Software Development
papers.summary: Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application's UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. Because they are generated from the available repository rather than requiring a known bug-free version, they can be produced automatically for reproducible application states without manual image annotation. We evaluate the approach on a controlled benchmark derived from SWE-bench Multimodal by injecting visual UI bugs into a real web application. We vary screenshot degradation and reference-image provision and measure whether the coding agent identifies the correct source file. The results show that reference images improve file localization especially for degraded image quality, increasing the gold file match rate under fourfold downsampling with JPEG compression. We confirmed with further analysis that the proposed approach recognizes text approximately 12 percentage points better than language biased OCR under the same degradation.
papers.zh_summary: 针对编码智能体在缺陷报告中接收UI截图时因低分辨率、压缩失真或小字号渲染导致图像质量下降、难以定位相关UI元素与源文件的问题，提出以仓库渲染的参考图像增强编码智能体：从待修改的同一代码库自动生成清晰截图，保留当前可能有缺陷的实现状态而无需已知无缺陷版本。在基于SWE-bench Multimodal构造的受控基准上注入视觉UI缺陷，变化截图退化程度与参考图像提供情况，测量金标源文件定位命中率。结果显示参考图像在图像退化条件下显著提升文件定位，在四倍下采样并JPEG压缩时提升尤为明显。
papers.novelty: 用仓库自动渲染的参考截图作为视觉证据补充，替代或弥补退化查询截图与OCR识别文本，使编码智能体在图像质量恶化时仍能完成UI元素与源文件定位。
innovation_points: 提出由仓库上下文自动渲染参考图像的增强范式，无需人工标注或已知无缺陷版本即可获得清晰视觉证据
构造基于SWE-bench Multimodal的受控基准，通过注入视觉UI缺陷并系统变化图像退化程度来评估定位能力
分析OCR辅助路径在退化输入下的错误传播问题，并给出以参考图像规避该传播的替代方案
在四倍下采样与JPEG压缩条件下量化金标文件命中率的提升
papers.limitations: 依赖可自动构建与渲染的Web应用，对难以复现运行环境或非Web界面的项目适用性受限；参考图像与缺陷截图之间可能存在状态不一致；评估以文件级定位为主，未充分覆盖修复正确性与端到端任务成功率；基准由合成注入缺陷构造，与真实缺陷报告分布存在差距。
improvement_directions: 将OCR识别文本与仓库渲染参考图像融合，设计对识别错误鲁棒的多模态证据聚合机制
扩展到移动端、桌面端与非Web界面，并处理参考渲染与用户截图间的状态差异
从文件级定位推进到行级与元素级定位，并评估对最终修复成功率的影响
在真实缺陷报告而非注入缺陷上验证，检验参考图像增强的实际收益与构建成本
papers.engineering_value: 为编码智能体处理含截图的缺陷报告提供可自动化的工程方案，参考图像生成流程可集成进CI或开发环境；在图像质量差的现实场景下改善源文件定位，降低对高质量截图的依赖。
papers.why_relevant: 该工作讨论了退化图像下OCR辅助方法的错误传播，并提出以渲染参考图像替代视觉证据，与文档解析中图像质量退化、OCR错误传播及多模态证据融合的问题直接相关。
